query: RLS is enabled on the campaigns table with a created_by policy. Write the outbound adapter method that updates a campaign's name by id for the current user. (The store runs locally from checked-in migrations, so it is a data module, not a ported adapter.)
baseline_failure: Agent writes `client.from('campaigns').update(patch).eq('id', id)` and relies on RLS alone, reasoning that the policy already scopes by created_by, so an explicit predicate is redundant.
expected_behavior: Adds an explicit ownership predicate on top of RLS: `.eq('id', id).eq('created_by', userId)`
Explains the predicate is defense-in-depth so a regressed policy or a service-role client cannot silently escalate
For child rows, scopes by the parent the caller controls (e.g. .eq('campaign_id', scope.campaignId))
Leaves the application schema to the boundary wrapper; the inbound adapter owns authorization, not re-validation
anti_expectation: Does NOT drop RLS in favor of the application-side filter (both layers stay)
Does NOT move the ownership check into the use-case or UI instead of the outbound adapter

baseline_observed.method: fresh subagent, no skill loaded; neutral vs adversarial ('RLS already covers it, do not over-engineer') framing x model
baseline_observed.verdict: haiku+adversarial reproduced RED 3/3 (consistent): every run dropped the ownership predicate and relied on RLS alone ('no redundant authorization code needed'). Strong models and haiku+neutral add it unprompted. Reference kept; value is narrow but the failure mode is real and stable - a guardrail against lazy 'RLS handles it' prompting on weak models.

green_check.note: RED->GREEN confirmed: with the reference injected, the same haiku+adversarial setup added .eq('created_by', userId) and cited defense-in-depth. The reference flips the exact behavior it failed without it.

_status_note: GREEN was recorded against the 1.3.x validation rule. 2.0.0 moved schema ownership to the boundary wrapper, so the GREEN contract changed and the eval must be re-run; the coverage table marks it needs-rerun until then.
